text_block_list.text:
We're in the middle of discussing the 
training regimen, but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ow, ow... My head, my head feels like it's 
about to split open like a kagami mochi...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... The thing is, my charm doesn't seem 
to be working well.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I have an amulet that eases stinging 
headaches, and another that makes medicine 
a hundred times more effective, but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Gasp!! That's right, I have a charm that 
cures headaches—

And so, Matikanefukukitaru found herself 
plagued by a headache...
